$comment: Design Engineering Toolkit CLI family — ComposeOutput. Major version 1. Deterministic output of one native-content compose adapter run (issue #23 G3): the emitted native content document, the per-source-node accountability map (every planned source node lands in exactly one of mapped / gap / decoration-merged / excluded / skipped), and diagnostics from the closed converter registry. The adapter must echo the core's input pins; the core re-verifies them and hard-rejects any mismatch (ADAPTER_CONTRACT_MISMATCH). Proof discipline: a compose output is structural composition evidence ONLY — it never claims Admin round-trip or visual verification.
title: Design Engineering Toolkit — Compose Output

platformId.description: Must equal the profile platformId the core dispatched with.

source.description: The design-source revision the content was composed from — must equal the PageStructure's pinned source.

projectionContentHash.description: Present iff a semantic projection was supplied with the compose input.

inputs.description: Echo of the exact input identities the adapter composed from; the core recomputes and compares all of them.

content.description: The emitted native content document in the platform's persisted (master) format. Empty only when nothing could be composed — the core treats an empty document as a blocking failure, never as success.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of the exact content string; the core recomputes and compares.

mapping.description: Source node -> native content accountability. Sorted by sourceNodeId.

diagnostics.description: Compose findings in canonical diagnostic order. Gaps (missing content inputs, non-representable decorations) are NOT_VERIFIED warnings with the affected node as subject — never silently dropped, never invented around.

sourceNodeId.description: The NodeIR node id this entry accounts for.

sourceName.description: Observed source name, for human-readable reports only.

sourceLocator.description: The design:// locator from the node's pinned evidence.

disposition.description: mapped = realized in the emitted content; gap = no native equivalent or missing content input (diagnostic attached); decoration-merged = pure decoration folded/excluded by policy; excluded = hidden or out of plan; skipped = planned but not composable by this slice's composer.

nativeElement.description: Platform-native element/role the node realized (adapter-documented vocabulary).

nativeField.description: Platform-native editable field the node's content landed in.

note.description: One human-readable sentence on how/why; never a substitute for the disposition or diagnostics.
